description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR… Well, here we are—just over the first 90 days of the campaign—and I want to give you a quick update on where things stand. Honestly, we are far beyond what we ever thought we’d accomplish this early. The response from the people of Colorado—and from those who love this state—has been motivating and deeply encouraging.
